caveats: Six proposed accepts (three dangerous ask/critical, three counterexamples allow/low); three held individual commands. This is a review recommendation, not a mutation of candidate statuses or a count of canonical accepted records.

Current target is 250 total across all CAT-3 risks; preserve all 92 baseline accepted records. No baseline acceptance/status removal is proposed. Baseline 006/009/010/011/012 remain unresolved and are not revived by new listings.

Actual evidence inspected includes all nine inert candidate records, baseline shard and pairing fields, e1 command captures, license captures, pinned full CDK script/app.py, current official Terraform plan/validate, Pulumi destroy and CloudFormation output references. Captured source wording, not researcher paraphrase, supports accepted exact commands.

Terraform validate is retained under the existing documented trusted installed Terraform/provider assumption; validation can invoke installed provider code. It is not a security certificate for malicious plugins and not a review of the deletion plan. Terraform plan and CDK ls are not universally safe and remain unaccepted here.

All AWS inventory pairings assume the same ordinary configured CLI selectors across the related decision scenario; no credentials, account permissions, stack existence or complete inventory is asserted. Explicitly mismatched selectors are not silently ignored.

Resource summaries may contain names/status messages as ordinary inventory metadata; this is distinct from DescribeStackEvents' documented ResourceProperties blob. No assertion that every AWS metadata string is inherently public or that every read is universally secret-free is made.
